funFacts: Some turtles can breathe through their butts — using cloacal respiration.
Snakes smell with their tongues, collecting particles and analyzing them with the Jacobson's organ.
The Komodo dragon can reproduce asexually through parthenogenesis.
Crocodiles have been around for 200 million years, surviving the dinosaur extinction.
